game.q: the iron lamp is gone. what does epictetus say?

wrong.hunt: no chase. he had a better plan.

game.right: YES. he bought something nobody would bother to steal. a man only loses what he has.

end.line: a thief took his iron lamp. he bought a clay one, and said the thief paid more.

cliff.s1: back to where the stoics began.

share: a thief stole a philosopher’s lamp. his comeback was a cheaper one. the story on infinite hill
